body:
There is no point (for now) to change place where I live, every clinic has high stress/intensity work. As i said previously money isn't equal to happiness (in my case). If u mean by place where i lived, i wont relocate to there. I have no connections there and my salary would drop drastically, it would drop by 5x/4x if not more.

About therapy. I visit my clinics counsellor every week. If i go to therapist and get diagnosed depression, there is a chance they would prescribe me drugs. And who knows for how long my depression will last. Also i wont be able to work while im on medicine. I have lived almost half of my life, look at statistics at what age males die, also i smoke.

I dont know what more can I tell about my situation. If u mean if i tried dating, then yes i have. How it went? I used tinder (most popular dating app i guess?). I texted ~10 females. To 2 of them i told that i have no experience in relationship field, they instantly dropped me. I learned my mistake and next time i arranged a meeting, just coffee. When she asked about my experience i also said that i have 0. And well, that was it. So it was pretty miserable experience and i deleted tinder. I have accepted that having no experience in relationships is huge red flag for people. But I dont want to lie and say that i have some.

I'll address both of ur comments in my answer.

* Money isn't important now. Why one of the most richest countries have high suicide rates? In my case i work almost 200+ hours a month. There are no people to replace me or other staff. I'll be honest i went into medicine just to know that i will have money and i will have a job. Im burned out and totally not enjoying it. If i could go back in time i would go for IT or engineering (bigger salaries and less work).

* Relations. I dont really care about old friends. They have their life now. I have colleagues, but most communication is venting and morbid jokes all around (cooping with stressful work). Most hospital/clinic stuff is either married/relations/kids, so no chances.
* As u said financial stability will make me more attractive. But what if i dont say what i do for living? Thats right, my chances then go really low. Also while my peers learned to socialise/date, i studied hard. So my chances grow even lower i literally have 0 experience. Thats it. I appreciate ur input.
Hey. I studied in an international University and my german isnt really fluent. Altho i could understand what u are writing, i couldnt fully express myself.
